items.name: Basic Sword
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Among Demons game Bag inventory item icon
Input images: Image 1 and Image 2 are approved demon style references; Image 3 is the approved Bag item rendering reference; Image 4 is the Bag environment color-and-contrast reference. Use all images only to match the project's graphic language and readability. Do not copy a creature, bottle, room, or emblem.
Primary request: create one simple basic one-handed sword as a production-ready standalone inventory asset.
Subject: a plain practical short sword with one broad straight steel blade, a simple slightly curved blue-slate crossguard, a short brown leather-wrapped grip reduced to two or three broad bands, and a small ochre/brass pommel. Sturdy and charming, ordinary starter equipment, unmistakably a sword at 64px.
Style/medium: expressive hand-inked 2D cartoon matching the approved Among Demons art: confident near-black organic contour, sparse interior lines, broad matte color blocks, and at most one simple hard-edged shadow per material. Chunky simplified proportions; no realistic metal rendering.
Composition/framing: one complete sword centered on a square canvas, rotated gently from lower-left toward upper-right, occupying about 82% of the canvas while keeping every tip inside generous transparent padding. Straight-on icon presentation, no perspective scene.
Color palette: pale cool steel-gray blade with one blue-gray shadow plane; dark desaturated navy/blue-slate guard; warm medium-brown grip; one restrained ochre/brass pommel accent. Strong readable contrast against the Bag's dark teal crypt.
Materials/textures: matte simplified steel, matte guard, simple leather; only large flat shapes.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background with clean alpha; no floor, no cast shadow, no border, no tile, no badge, no bottle, no scenery, no text, no logo, no watermark. The blade and all parts must form one coherent object. Readable at 64px.
Avoid: ornate fantasy design, runes, gems, spikes, skulls, faces, demon features, flames, blood, rust, scratches, chips, glow, bloom, particles, gradients, glossy reflections, thin white highlights, bevel noise, photorealism, 3D rendering, tiny details, rarity effects.

items.name: Executioner
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Among Demons game Bag equipment item icon
Input images: Image 1 is the approved Basic Sword and the strongest reference for exact line weight, flat rendering, diagonal composition, padding, and shared equipment materials. Image 2 is an approved demon style reference. Image 3 is an approved chunky Bag-item rendering reference. Image 4 is the Bag environment color-and-contrast reference. Use them only to match the established graphic language; do not copy a creature, bottle, room, sword shape, fist, or anvil.
Primary request: create the equipment item "Executioner" from equipment-items.json as one production-ready standalone heavy executioner's axe. It is a damage/execute weapon that deals bonus damage to weakened enemies, so communicate decisive weight through silhouette only.
Subject: one intimidating but simple two-handed headsman's axe. A single enormous broad steel axe head with a long straight upper edge, a strong forward blade, and a deep squared lower beard; a compact dark blue-slate socket; a thick practical medium-brown wooden haft with two or three broad dark leather grip bands; and one small restrained ochre/brass butt cap. The head must dominate the silhouette and unmistakably read as an axe at 64px. No second blade.
Style/medium: the same expressive hand-inked 2D cartoon as the approved Basic Sword and demons: confident near-black organic contour, sparse interior lines, broad matte color blocks, and at most one simple hard-edged shadow per material. Chunky simplified proportions, not realistic fantasy rendering.
Composition/framing: one complete axe centered on a square canvas, rotated gently from lower-left toward upper-right in the same visual family as the Basic Sword. Occupy about 82% of the canvas with generous transparent padding and every extremity fully visible. Straight-on icon presentation, no perspective scene.
Color palette: pale cool steel-gray blade with one blue-gray shadow plane; dark desaturated navy/blue-slate socket; warm medium-brown haft and grip; one restrained ochre/brass butt-cap accent. Strong readable contrast against the Bag's dark teal crypt.
Materials/textures: matte simplified steel, matte blue-slate socket, flat wood and leather; only large readable shapes.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background with clean alpha; no floor, no cast shadow, no border, no tile, no badge, no scenery, no text, no logo, no watermark. All parts form one coherent axe. Rarity remains outside the artwork.
Avoid: sword, double-headed axe, halberd, scythe, ornate fantasy design, runes, gems, spikes, skulls, faces, demon features, blood, gore, flames, glow, bloom, particles, rust, scratches, chips, gradients, glossy reflections, thin white highlights, bevel noise, photorealism, 3D rendering, tiny details, rarity effects.
